points: Survey of 202 Austrian cloud-using firms with 20+ staff, April-May 2026
58% are checking whether sovereign offers fit; 50% look for alternatives because of geopolitics
76% run multi-cloud; 45% a balanced public-private hybrid
take: A hard number for the sovereignty premium in a German-speaking market. Useful benchmark when pricing sovereign or EU-only cloud options against hyperscaler defaults.
title: KPMG Austria: 42% would pay up to 20% more for sovereign cloud
